title: In This Body
author: Prabashini Mahakuda
text:
On this day the burden of fifty-eight years
Of boons , blood , flesh , the marrow and hair , tears
Passion , anger , indifference , love
Thoughts , consciousness regard , insult .
This body bends down , the warmth of the body lessens
The different stories of life
She has seen life in delicate dreams
The half seen dream has ruined suddenly in mid night
Some dreams fall like tears on a pillow
The dreams has something beautiful
Something unlovely and too
The reality`s some coloured , some black and white drawings
What does the body do when burden on body increases
She tells the morning light to lessen the burden
She did not sleep last night
She was suffocated due to asthma and cold
She pleads to the Lord to keep the day calm and gentle
For the last eight months she has been enduring
The private grief of loss that burns down everything
If nothing else , offer her an adversary
Who would be equal to her ,just like her
And he should be always ready
to carry her burden far above life
The burden of her body
Slowly makes her lonely -
Friendless and sad cheerless .
